messages:
devin: FYI I've opened PR #4910 — consolidates migration notes, fixes broken SDK links, and updates a few code examples. Preview shows a style warning and one broken anchor. Can someone eyeball terminology and the examples?
ana: On it. Which terms are you standardizing?
devin: Trying to consistently use 'Redwood Private' for the product name and avoid generic 'private' when ambiguous. Also switching imperative steps to second-person.
marcus: I skimmed the JS example — it still uses old method names (createChat). Recommend updating to the new client API and mark code blocks with language. Example suggestion: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'Hello' });
```
marcus: Also don't include region or plaintext keys. Use env var pattern.
violet: Docs bot flagged anchor #streaming-quickstart missing and a line-length lint at 78 chars. I can fix the anchor and wrap the long sentence.
docs-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4910 - Link-check: 1 broken link, 1 lint warning.
ana: Small style nits: 1) use present tense, 2) prefer 'you' for instructions, 3) API identifiers in inline code (``redwood.Client``), 4) examples should be short and copy-paste friendly.
devin: Thanks — updated the product name and tense in the intro. Pushed a commit replacing 'private deployment' with 'Redwood Private' and reworded passive sentences.
marcus: Updated the JS snippet in a follow-up commit. Also added a tiny streaming pseudo-example and linked to the streaming guide instead of inlining many lines.
violet: I added the missing anchor and fixed line-length. Also marked code fences with language tags. New preview should appear shortly.
docs-bot: New preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4910/2 - Link-check: 0 broken links, 0 warnings.
marcus: LGTM for code. One last thought: add a brief migration callout box for anyone upgrading older clients. Keeps expectations clear.
ana: Approved — voice and terminology look consistent now. Adding :thumbsup:
devin: Thanks all. Will wait for another approval then merge during the docs morning window to avoid peak CI.
marcus: Approved. Tagging `ready/merge`.
devin: Merged in the window. Closing the PR and adding a changelog entry. Thanks everyone. :tada:
